message: Request: Write exactly 3 English nurture emails for opted-in electronics hobbyists considering their first general repair toolkit. Promote the iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit using only official source facts. Email 1 helps assess whether the kit fits their repair work, email 2 explains a concrete tool use from the material, email 3 resolves a supported buying concern. Each email must stand alone, build a distinct argument, and point to the product page. No invented discounts, deadlines, cart activity, personal knowledge, or guaranteed repair outcomes. Readers have not purchased yet.
